problem_statement: Build a brand-new Plans & Pricing page at the route /plans on the SvelteKit SaaS Kit site. The route does not exist yet (navigating to /plans currently 404s). Create the SvelteKit route file src/routes/(marketing)/plans/+page.svelte so the page renders inside the site's existing marketing shell (sticky header nav + footer) and reuses the design system (Tailwind design tokens: card/border/primary/muted-foreground, the Section landing components, and the Button component). The page must present three pricing tiers (Starter, Pro, Enterprise) as cards with a price, a short blurb, a call-to-action button, and a feature list. Add ONE real interaction: a monthly/annual billing toggle. The page loads showing Monthly prices; clicking the Annual control must swap every plan's displayed price to the discounted annual per-month amount and update the billing note. The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: Page heading 'Plans & Pricing' (h1) inside the marketing shell
A billing-cycle toggle with a Monthly control and an Annual control (default = Monthly)
A billing note that reads 'Billed monthly — cancel anytime.' in the default (monthly) state
Three plan cards: Starter, Pro, Enterprise, each with an h3 title
Each plan card shows a price (e.g. $0 / $12 / $49 per month for monthly) and a '/ month' unit
Each plan card has a short blurb paragraph and a call-to-action Button (Get Starter/Pro/Enterprise)
Each plan card lists its features (Unlimited projects, Priority email support, SSO & audit logs, etc.)
Interaction: clicking Annual swaps prices to the annual per-month amounts ($0 / $9 / $39) and changes the note to mention annual savings
Responsive layout: single-column plan grid on mobile (390px) with zero horizontal overflow
The featured/Pro plan card is visually highlighted with a primary-colored border (border-primary #171717) while other cards use the neutral border (#e5e5e5)
design_constraints: Reuse the marketing layout group (marketing) so the page inherits the site header nav and footer
Reuse Tailwind design tokens: bg-card / text-card-foreground / border-border / border-primary / text-muted-foreground / bg-primary / text-primary-foreground
Reuse the Section landing components (Section.Root / Section.Header / Section.Description) and the shared Button component
Toggle controls must carry a unique data-billing attribute (data-billing="monthly" / data-billing="annual") so they are selectable without relying on shell-chrome text

Color palette (Tailwind design tokens, from the reference): primary bg-primary = #171717 (rgb 23,23,23) with text-primary-foreground = #fafafa; card surface bg-card = #ffffff with text #0a0a0a; borders border-border = #e5e5e5 and the highlighted/featured plan uses border-primary = #171717; secondary text text-muted-foreground = #737373. The page background stays white; the primary CTA buttons are dark (#171717) with light text.
